parameters.name: confidence_threshold
parameters.label: Confidence Threshold
parameters.description: Detections with confidence below this value are discarded (Confidence Filtering).

parameters.name: density_unit
parameters.label: Density Unit
parameters.description: Unit used for the tree density metric.

parameters.name: detector
parameters.label: Detection Model
parameters.description: Detection backend. 'opencv_watershed' is the built-in classical crown detector (Excess Green, Otsu, distance-transform peaks) and needs no weights. 'deeplabv3plus' is the agreed deep-learning model and needs model_path, torch and segmentation-models-pytorch. 'stub' returns no detections and only exercises the pipeline.

parameters.name: model_path
parameters.label: DeepLabV3+ Checkpoint (.pth)
parameters.description: Absolute path to the trained DeepLabV3+ weights. Required by 'deeplabv3plus'; ignored by the other detectors.

parameters.name: backbone
parameters.label: DeepLabV3+ Backbone
parameters.description: Encoder of the checkpoint. Must be the encoder used during training, otherwise the weights cannot be loaded.

parameters.name: probability_threshold
parameters.label: Canopy Probability Threshold
parameters.description: A pixel counts as tree canopy above this model probability ('deeplabv3plus' only). Lower it to catch thinner crowns, raise it if bare soil is detected as trees.

parameters.name: iou_threshold
parameters.label: Duplicate Overlap (IoU)
parameters.description: Overlapping boxes above this IoU are treated as the same tree (de-duplication across tiles).

parameters.name: tile_size
parameters.label: Tile Size (px)
parameters.description: Size of the square tiles the image is split into before inference.

parameters.name: gsd_cm
parameters.label: Ground Sampling Distance (cm/px)
parameters.description: Used only when the image metadata has no gsd_m value.
